question: Is the reported unchanged-update Docker scenario sufficient, or must this PR demonstrate the config-sensitive npm fallback in a real packed installation before merge?
rationale: The only intended behavioral correction affects installation-policy propagation, while the supplied live scenario does not visibly exercise that fallback branch.

options.title: Require fallback proof
options.body: Run a packed scenario that triggers beta npm fallback with a non-default install policy and publish redacted output before merge.

options.title: Accept current evidence
options.body: Treat the focused regression assertion plus unchanged-update Docker run as sufficient proof for this refactor.

recommendation.title: Require fallback proof
recommendation.body: Run a packed scenario that triggers beta npm fallback with a non-default install policy and publish redacted output before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: This is the only evidence-backed routing candidate available after repository-history inspection was blocked.
